name: ks
description: knowledge-scout: search a private technical knowledge-card pool with A/B/C judging, run low-frequency web research, and add cards

ks_path.title: ks executable
ks_path.description: Path to the installed `ks` executable (for example the output of `command -v ks`)

data_dir.title: Card data directory
data_dir.description: Private directory that holds `cards/` and one vocabulary file: `vocab/terms.yaml`, `vocab/terms.yml`, or `vocab/terms.json`

redis_url.title: Redis URL
redis_url.description: Index server URL with its password, for example redis://:<password>@127.0.0.1:6379
